Enabled.Name: Close idle worlds
Enabled.Hint: Master switch. When everyone connected has been idle long enough, a countdown starts and the world is closed afterwards.

Minutes.Name: Idle minutes
Minutes.Hint: Minutes without any input (mouse, keyboard, touch) from every connected user before the countdown starts.

Countdown.Name: Countdown seconds
Countdown.Hint: How long the "Still there?" dialog counts down before the world is closed.

Action.Name: When the countdown ends
Action.Hint: With a Gamemaster connected, only that client acts. Without one, everybody is logged out and a server-side watchdog (if any) closes the world.

Dialog.Title: Still there?
Dialog.Body: Nobody has been active for a while. The world closes in {seconds} seconds. Move the mouse or press any key to stay.
Dialog.BodyLogout: Nobody has been active for a while. Everyone is logged out in {seconds} seconds. Move the mouse or press any key to stay.
